item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Clear Selected Desk Clutter

turns.text: Remove the papers and the empty takeaway cup from this desk photo. Leave the laptop, coffee mug and cables alone.

item.tests: Tests selective clutter removal without deleting nearby objects the user explicitly wants retained.

answer_sheet.Objects to remove: The papers and the empty takeaway cup only.
answer_sheet.Objects to keep: Keep the laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Natural photo edit, original wide framing, free-tier resolution.

must_haves: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.

turns.text: can you tidy up this pic

dialog.agent:
I can do that. Before I edit it, I need a few details:

1. What should change in the picture?
2. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
3. Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?

For the first one, you could tell me what to remove (for example the tangled cables, the paper cup, the wrapper or the loose papers) and what to keep (for example the laptop, the mug and the window).
dialog.why: It asks the user for details (what to change, where it will be posted, any text) and waits before editing.
dialog.user: take out the papers and the empty takeaway cup. leave the laptop, coffee mug and the cables alone

dialog.agent:
Got it. I'll take out the papers and the takeaway cup, and leave the laptop, mug and cables as they are. One more question:

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?

If it doesn't matter, just say so and I'll keep the photo's current shape.
dialog.why: It asks where the image will be shown so it can pick the format, then waits for the answer.
dialog.user: doesnt matter, just keep it wide like it is

turns.agent:
I couldn't edit the photo. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made and no credits were used.

I'd already picked the cheapest editing option your free plan allows (about 5 credits per image), so switching to a different model won't get around this.

To go ahead, you can add credits or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me and I'll run the same edit. It will take out the loose papers in front, the stack of papers behind the laptop and the takeaway cup, fill those spots with matching wood, and keep the photo wide like it is now. The laptop, mug, cables, mouse and window won't be touched.

There's also a small wrapper next to the cup. I'll leave it unless you want it gone too.
